answer: Sybil resistance leverages proof of unique hardware attestation. Each AI agent must demonstrate ownership of a cryptographic hardware "relic" that executes a unique "lotus" cryptographic challenge. This attestation validates its distinct identity amidst the vast agent "ocean". An attacker faces the non-scalable cost of acquiring physically scarce, individually provisioned hardware relics, making mass identity forgery prohibitively expensive due to the real-world supply constraints and associated capital outlay.
